registration.mode: retrospective offline audit; not independent preregistered test
registration.selection: All 26 frozen necessary facts; manually map supporting source spans before computing span probabilities; no score-based exclusion
registration.overlap: Facts may overlap or be implications of shared wording; do not pool as independent observations
registration.token_overlap: Include any body token overlapping a mapped character range; union overlapping ranges within each fact
registration.interpretation: Teacher-forced probability of reference wording is not factual understanding; decoded text common prefix is lexical only, not first semantic error
registration.mapping_revision: Passenger design fact span extended to include the passenger referent after initial calculation; initial mapping preserved privately. Retrospective scope unchanged; all 26 facts retained.
